description: Single-objective operational sub-problem on C-Town, aligned with Sousa & Muranho (2016) JWRPM 142(5) and the variable-speed pump scheduling literature (Menapace et al. 2024, arXiv:2309.04715). The network is from Marchi et al. (2014) BWN-II, JWRPM 140(7).
citation: Marchi A., Salomons E., Ostfeld A., et al. (2014). Battle of the Water Networks II. J. Water Resour. Plann. Manage., 140(7).
Sousa J., Muranho J. (2016). Optimal Management of Water Distribution Networks with Simulated Annealing: The C-Town Problem. J. Water Resour. Plann. Manage., 142(5).
Menapace A., et al. (2024). Optimal scheduling of variable speed pumps with mixed integer linear programming. Water Supply, 24(7). arXiv:2309.04715.
